Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the third innings. KL Rahul and Mayank Agarwal walk out to the middle with their swords. South African players are seen to be in a huddle, before they take their respective fielding positions. Kagiso Rabada to steam in with the cherry. Here we go...
... THIRD INNINGS ...

South Africa get bundled out for 210 runs. Some valuable runs by the tail-enders cut down the deficit to 13 runs. Who else? It was Bumrah who gets his five-fer his seventh in Test cricket. Thakur chipped in with a wicket as well. But they could not end things as quickly as they would’ve liked too. Rabada and Olivier battled solidly in the middle, the former took some nasty body blows. The hosts fought till the very end but India would be really happy with their performance. They will come out to bat and hope they remain unscathed till the Stumps. But with the new ball, the hosts will certainly not make it easy for the Indian batters. Do join us in a short while.

OUT! CAUGHT! Jasprit Bumrah gets his five-fer! Take a bow, Jasprit Bumrah. South Africa have been bundled out for 210!  A length ball, around off. Lungi Ngidi looks to flick but gets a leading edge towards extra cover. Ravichandran Ashwin takes the easiest catch to dismiss the last man Lungi Ngidi.
Commentary.Howout: c Ravichandran Ashwin b Jasprit Bumrah

Commentary.Commentary: Short, on middle. Ngidi looks to pull it away but misses.
Back of a length, on the bodyline. Ngidi flicks it to mid-wicket. But the ball evades the short mid-wicket fielder.
Shorter ball, on the pads. Duanne Olivier misses his flick and gets rapped on the pads.
Very full, almost a yorker. Duanne Olivier jabs it out.
A full ball, outside off. Duanne Olivier blocks it out.
Full and on off. Olivier defends it back to the bowler.
Fuller again, on the pads. Duanne Olivier taps it to short fine leg.
Full again, around middle and off. Duanne Olivier defends it out.
Loopy ball, around middle, Duanne Olivier blocks it out.
A low full toss, on middle. Lungi Ngidi pushes it towards mid off. Jasprit Bumrah will have to wait a tad longer for his fifth.
A fuller ball, around middle. Lungi Ngidi gets a thin outside edge that falls short of the second slip.
CLOSE! Full-length, on off. Lungi Ngidi stays back and chips it back to the bowler. Bumrah dives to his left but the ball evades him.
On a length, on the pads. Lungi Ngidi pushes it uppishly towards mid on.
And again! A replica of the previous delivery. Back of a length, outside off. Lungi Ngidi gets beaten on the outside edge once again.
BEATEN! A ripper! Touch shorter, outside off. Lungi Ngidi stays in his crease and tires to block but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Touch fuller, around off. Duanne Olivier leans and blocks it.
Shorter ball, outside off. Lungi Ngidi, on back foot, slashes it towards backward point for a single.
Back of a length, around middle. Lungi Ngidi stays in the crease and defends it out.
Shorter ball, around middle. Lungi Ngidi ducks underneath it.
Length ball, around middle. Lungi Ngidi blocks it solidly.
A fuller ball, around middle. Lungi Ngidi drives it past mid-wicket for two runs. He gets off the mark with that.
Length ball, on the pads. Duanne Olivier tucks it towards mid on.
On a length, outside off. Duanne Olivier hangs back and cuts it past point for a brace.
Shorter this time, outside off. Duanne Olivier, on back foot, punches it towards cover.
Fuller, outside off. Duanne Olivier looks to drive but fails to get any connection on that.

FOUR! EDGY! Duanne Olivier gets lucky! A length ball, around off. Duanne Olivier looks to block this but gets a thick inside edge just past the leg stump. The ball races away towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Back of a length, outside off. Duanne Olivier leans back and lets that go through.
A length ball, on off. Lungi Ngidi defends it back to the bowler.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Lungi Ngidi defends it to mid-wicket off the inner half.
Fuller ball, on middle. Lungi Ngidi blocks it out solidly.
Lungi Ngidi is the last man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Change of field works for India! Kagiso Rabada gets trapped. A full ball, around off. Kagiso Rabada takes the aerial route once again and lofts it towards long off. Jasprit Bumrah runs on the left a tad and takes a comfortable catch. India one wicket away now to bat once again.
Commentary.Howout: c Jasprit Bumrah b Shardul Thakur

Commentary.Commentary: A full ball, around middle. Kagiso Rabada lofts it over mid off over for a brace. Virat Kohli now pushes the mid off fielder behind.
A length ball, around middle. Blocked out.
A full ball, around middle. Duanne Olivier defends it out solidly.
Spinning in, around off. Duanne Olivier blocks it out.
Another flighted ball, on middle. Duanne Olivier lens and blocks it out.
Loopy ball, full and on middle. Duanne Olivier defends it out.
Full and on middle. Kagiso Rabada pushes it uppishly towards mid off. A single taken.
An appeal for LBW, but the umpire is unmoved A quicker one, on the pads. Kagiso Rabada misses his flick and gets rapped on the pads. That was probably drifting down leg.
Short ball, on middle and leg. Rabada pulls it to deep square leg for a single. He retains the strike.

A slight halt in play. Kagiso Rabada has been struck on the helmet. A mandatory concussion check will be done. The physio is out in the middle to do the needful. Hence the umpires have also signaled for a drinks break. India have sent back the sent-batter Petersen and now are attacking the bowlers. But Rabada and Olivier are fighting out really well in the middle and frustrating the Indian bowlers. India would hope they can take the remaining wickets before the hosts could cut down the deficit.
OUCH! Back of a length, on middle. Rabada looks to pull it away but misses and gets hit on the helmet. That is a nasty blow. The batter will go through the mandatory concussion test.
Short, down leg. Rabada looks to pull it away but misses.
FOUR! Short ball, on the bodyline. Rabada hangs back and pulls it behind square for a boundary.
Short ball, on middle. Rabada looks to flick it away, but the ball goes to the off side off the outside edge.
WIDE! Short ball, on leg, it flies over the batter. The umpire signals a wide.
Full, on off, angled across the left-hander. Rabada defends it back to the bowler.
Fuller, outside off. Duanne Olivier drives it to cover with soft hands.

FOUR! Duanne Olivier gets off the mark with a boundary. A very confident shot. Touch short, on off. Duanne Olivier leans back and guides it through backward point for a boundary. Adds valuable runs to the total.
Very full, on middle and leg, this time a slower one. Olivier digs it out solidly.
Olivier yet to get off the mark. So runs are coming only from one end for the hosts. A length ball, on off. Olivier blocks it out solidly.
Good length, on the stumps. Olivier defends it to point.
Low full toss, outside off. Rabada pushes it towards mid off for a quick single.
Short ball, on off. Olivier leans back and leaves it alone for the keeper.
Short ball, on off. Olivier looks to defend it out but gets hit on his elbow this time. He is taking some blows for his side here.
Short ball, on off. Olivier sways away from the line.
Full length, on off. Olivier drives it to mid off. Mayank Agarwal does well to stop it.
Length ball, on off. Rabada defends it to cover for a quick single.
NO BALL! Short ball, on off. Rabada looks to play across the line but misses. The bowler oversteps and the umpire calls it a no ball.

A stifled appeal from Yadav but the umpire is unmoved. Back of a length, on the bodyline. Rabada looks to pull it away but misses. Yadav thinks it came off the gloves and puts in a loud appeal but the umpire is not interested.
Full and outside off. Olivier blocks it to cover.
NO BALL! Short ball, angling down leg. Olivier ducks under it. The bowler oversteps and the umpire signals a no ball.
Full length, outside off. Olivier defends it to the off side.
Short ball, on the bodyline. Olivier stands back and defends it off his gloves. That should be painful.
Back of a length, on middle and leg. Olivier looks to defend it out but get hit above his arm band.
On off, blocked out.
CLOSE! Length ball, on off. Rabada gets an inside edge. The ball goes to square leg for a single.
Back of a length, on off. Olivier sways away from the line of delivery.
Outside off, left alone.
Length ball, angled in on middle. Duanne Olivier stays inside the crease and blocks it out.
Good length, outside off, nipping away. Duanne Olivier steps forward and looks to drive it away but gets beaten by the movement.
Umesh Yadav drops it short this time, on the body. Kagiso Rabada pulls it towards square leg for a single.
On a length, outside off. Kagiso Rabada takes the aerial route this time and lofts it over cover for a brace.
Another length ball, around off. Duanne Olivier blocks it out off the back foot.
Length ball, on middle. Duanne Olivier defends it out.
Duanne Olivier is the new man in.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! That's the wicket India were searching for and Jasprit Bumrah does the trick once again. A length ball, outside off. Keegan Petersen stands tall and looks to defend that but gets a thick outside edge to first slip. Cheteshwar Pujara at first slip, gets low, and grabs it comfortably. A perfect length, perfect line. Keegan Petersen's gritty innings comes to an end. Jasprit Bumrah is one wicket away from his five-fer!
Commentary.Howout: c Cheteshwar Pujara b Jasprit Bumrah

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller ball, around off. Keegan Petersen drives it to the man at extra cover.
Another shortish delivery, outside off. Keegan Petersen, on back foot, pushes it to the fielder at mid off.

Mohammed Shami is not on the field at the moment. Looks to be some knee issue. The physio is stretching his knee cap there. It was Mohammed Siraj who was playing with an injury in the last Test game. India would hope Shami's injury is not a serious one.
Touch shorter, on the body. Keegan Petersen blocks it out solidly off the back foot.
A shorter ball, on the body. Keegan Petersen pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single. He retains the strike.
Very full, on middle. Keegan Petersen dabs it back to the bowler.
Back of a length, outside off. Kagiso Rabada cuts it towards point off the back foot for a single. He gets off the mark with that run.
Length, on middle. Kagiso Rabada shows the full face of his bat and defends it back to the bowler.
On a length, outside off. Kagiso Rabada blocks it out towards cover.
A low full toss, on the pads. Keegan Petersen works it away towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Umesh Yadav to steam in from the other end.
A shorter ball, around middle. Kagiso Rabada leans back and lets that go through to the keeper.
Yorker length, on off. Kagiso Rabada jabs it out towards cover.
Good-length ball, outside off. Kagiso Rabada blocks it out solidly.
Jasprit Bumrah goes around the wicket, serves a length ball, outside off. Kagiso Rabada defends it out.

The final session is set to begin. The Indian players stride out to the middle. Followed by Keegan Petersen and Kagiso Rabada, the new man in who walk out to bat for the hosts. Jasprit Bumrah to complete his over.
... Day 2, Session 3 ...

South Africa are 7 down! They surely did not expect that to happen. The hosts lost Rassie van der Dussen early, but Bavuma and Petersen steadied the ship and added 47 runs together to put them on top. But the hosts were all over the place in the final hour of the session. They lost two wickets in one over and were under pressure since then. However, Keegan Petersen is still standing tall at the crease and adding crucial runs on the board, but he has no support at the other end. The Proteas would hope that he could hit some lusty blows in the final session of the day to close the gap with India. Do join us at 1900 IST (1330 GMT) to find out how things pan out.

India all the way! The visitors would definitely be the happier side at the end of this session. They have been exceptional with the ball. The bowlers have hit the right areas, and have grabbed the desired wickets. They clinched four wickets to put South Africa in trouble. Umesh Yadav struck early in the session and took the wicket of Rassie van der Dussen, who was looking uncomfortable at the crease. Shami followed up with two wickets in an over and put the hosts under pressure. Bumrah scalped his third wicket after knocking Marco Jansen just at brink of Tea.

OUT! TIMBER! Jasprit Bumrah does what he does best and gets his third wicket of the game. Brilliant by Bumrah. Until now, Bumrah was attacking Jansen with short deliveries but this time he bowls it on the stumps and Jansen pays the price. A length ball, around off, nipping in off the deck. Jansen looks to defend it out but misses and sees his off stump uprooted. Jasprit Bumrah wins this battle for sure and India go back as the happier side. THAT WILL BE TEA ON DAY 2.
Short ball, on the bodyline, Petersen pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Full length, outside off. Jansen defends it to the off side.
Fuller, on off. Jansen blocks it out.
Shami goes full and on the stumps this time. Jansen was thinking to leave the ball alone but gets his willow down in time to squeeze it out.
BEAUTY! Good-length ball, in the corridor of uncertainty. Jansen looks to push it away but gets beaten on the outside edge. Just a little bit of movement this time.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Keegan Petersen flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Touch short and outside off. Petersen hangs back and looks to work it to the leg side. The ball takes the inside edge and goes back to the bowler.
Nicely played! Full and outside off. Jansen leans in and drives it through covers for a couple of runs.
Short and on off. Petersen pulls it to square leg for a single.
Fuller, on off. Jansen pushes it to backward point for a quick single.
A full-length ball, outside off. This one nips in a bit and stays low off the deck. Jansen hangs his blade out but the ball goes past the outside edge.
Outside off, left alone by Jansen.
BEATEN! A good-length ball, outside off. This one holds its line. Jansen looks to defend it out but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Length ball, outside off. Petersen steps across and leaves it alone for the keeper.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Petersen flicks it to mid-wicket. Thakur tumbles in the field and the batters take two comfortably.
Shami continues to bowl it full, this time on off. Petersen defends it back to the bowler.
Full length, down leg. Jansen clips it to deep square leg for just a single, as a fielder is placed there.
Back of a length, outside off. Jansen leaves it alone for the keeper.
Fuller, on off. Jansen drives it towards cover.

LEG BYE! A length ball, on leg. Jansen leaves it alone and the ball strikes him on the pads and rolls to the leg side. Petersen is half way down the ground. Jansen started his run late but in the end, made it safely to the other end. They collect a leg bye.
Bumrah fires in a yorker, on leg. Jansen gets his blade down in time to dig it out.
Back of a length, outside off. Jansen leaves it alone for the keeper.
Nice delivery. Good length, outside off, shaping in. Jansen gets squared up and gets hit hgh on the pads.
BEAUTY! Good-length ball, outside off. This one flies off the deck. Jansen hangs his blade out but misses to push it away.
A sharp bouncer, on middle and leg. Jansen ducks under it.
FOUR! Crunches this one! A shorter ball, wide of off. Keegan Petersen hangs back and chops that through gully for a boundary.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Keegan Petersen lunges and blocks it out.

An appeal for caught behind, but the umpire says no. Touch shorter this time, nipping back in on middle. Keegan Petersen looks to defend this but gets beaten on the inside edge this time. The ball brushes off the thigh pad and flies towards the keeper. Good decision by the umpire.
Good-length delivery, around middle. Keegan Petersen gets an inside edge on to his pads
BEATEN! A JAFFA! Length ball, shaping away a tad, outside off. Keegan Petersen looks to defend this but gets beaten on the outside edge again.
A fuller delivery, around off. Keegan Petersen blocks it out to cover.
Full, outside off. Marco Jansen leans and defends it out.
Fuller this time, outside off. Marco Jansen pushes it through the outer half of his bat towards point for two runs.
Another bouncer! A shorter ball, around off. Marco Jansen ducks under it again. Rishabh Pant jumps high and fails to grab it as well.
Back of a length, around off. Marco Jansen ducks under it and lets that go through.
BEATEN! What a ripper by Jasprit Bumrah. A length ball, outside off, at 141 clicks. Marco Jansen looks to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
A short ball, outside off. Marco Jansen ducks underneath it.
Jasprit Bumrah comes back into the attack now. The boys in the dugout of India are clapping in rhythm along with the players on the field. Good team spirit shown here.
Length, on off, blocked out solidly.
Length ball, on the stumps. Jansen works it to mid-wicket off the inner half. They take a single.
Marco Jansen walks out to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Shami has worked his magic here. He picks up his second wicket of the over. South Africa in a spot of bother now. A full-length ball, outside off, drawing the batsman to play at it. Kyle Verreynne is tempted and he looks to drive it away. The ball takes the outside edge and flies low to the right of the keeper. Pant is quick to put in a dive to his right and gathers the ball before it lands on the field. India right on top now!
Commentary.Howout: c Rishabh Pant b Mohammed Shami

Commentary.Commentary: Length ball, on off. Kyle Verreynne defends it out solidly.
Kyle Verreynne comes to the crease now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Virat Kohli comes out with a stunning catch in the slips to find a crucial breakthrough. A short ball, around off, shaping away. Temba Bavuma looks to defend it out and gets a thick outside edge. The ball flies towards the slip cordon. Virat Kohli there dives to his left to take a sharp catch. This is also his 100th catch in Test matches. This is what India wanted.
Commentary.Howout: c Virat Kohli b Mohammed Shami

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Nicely played. Full length, outside off. Bavuma leans in and drives it through covers for a boundary.
Floated ball, around middle. Keegan Petersen leans and tucks it towards mid-wicket. Dot to end the over.
Loopy ball, full and on middle. Keegan Petersen taps it to the fielder at square leg.
Flatter and quicker, down the leg side. Keegan Petersen leaves that alone.
Fuller ball again, on the pads. Keegan Petersen clips it towards square leg for a brace.
Another full ball, tosses it up. Keegan Petersen steps down and flicks it towards mid-wicket. No run there.
Loopy ball, full and on middle. Keegan Petersen works it away towards mid-wicket.
Back of a length, on off. Bavuma gets inside the line and blocks it out solidly.
Full length, outside off. Bavuma leans in and looks to drive it away but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Back of a length, outside off, Bavuma leaves it alone for the keeper.
Outside off, left alone.
On a length, on off, defended out solidly.
Length, on off, blocked out.
Full and on middle. Petersen remains solid in his defense.
On off, blocked out.
Full and sliding down leg. Petersen looks to flick it away but misses.
Full and on middle. Petersen defends it to the leg side.
On off, blocked out watchfully.
Full and on leg. Keegan Petersen defends it to the leg side.
Very full this time, outside off. Temba Bavuma presses forward and pushes it towards extra cover.
Another length ball, outside off. Temba Bavuma leaves it alone.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Temba Bavuma offers no shot on that.
Much fuller this time, around the off pole. Temba Bavuma leans and drives it towards mid off.
Another short ball, outside off. Temba Bavuma cuts it towards deep cover for two runs.
FOUR! Back of a length, outside off. Temba Bavuma, hangs back and slashes that past point for a boundary.
Full and outside off. Petersen pushes it through covers for a brace.
Full, on the pads, Bavuma clips it to mid-wicket for a single.
On off, defended out.
Full and outside off. Bavuma works it to mid-wicket.
On middle, flicked to the leg side.
Looped up, full and on middle. Petersen come forward and flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Good-length ball, outside off. Temba Bavuma punches it to the fielder at cover.
A length ball, around off. Defended out solidly.

DROPPED! A chance goes down! A length ball, width on offer this time. Temba Bavuma looks to slash this but gets an outside edge towards first slip. Rishabh Pant dives to his right but the ball is away from him. Cheteshwar Pujara at first slip is a little late to get low for the catch. He gets both hands to it, but the ball pops out and rolls towards the helmet behind the keeper. This means that will be 5 runs!
LEG BYE! Good-length delivery, on the pads. Keegan Petersen misses his flick and the ball hits the pads and rolls towards fine leg. A leg bye taken in return.
Length ball, outside off. Keegan Petersen with a solid front foot defense.
Shorter, around middle. Keegan Petersen ducks underneath it.
Fuller ball, around middle. Temba Bavuma pushes it back to the bowler. The ball deflects off Shardul Thakur's hand towards mid on and the batters steal a quick run.

DRINKS! India started the session brilliantly as well. Umesh Yadav sent back Rassie van der Dussen pretty early on. Since then, India have been able to put the batters under pressure. But positively for the Proteas, Bavuma and Petersen have negotiated well and are well invested in the repair work. If this stand keeps on building the trajectory of the game can certainly change. India would like to take a couple of wickets before heading out for Tea.
Fuller, around middle. Keegan Petersen steps down again and works it away towards mid on. Fails to get it in the gap. Tidy over from Ravichandran Ashwin.
Shorter, quicker, on middle. Keegan Petersen hangs back and tucks it towards square leg. Dot ball.
Flatter, quicker, on middle. Keegan Petersen blocks it out solidly.
Fuller ball, on middle. Keegan Petersen advances down the pitch and pushes it towards long on for a single.
Loopy ball, around middle. Keegan Petersen presses forward and defends it out.
Flatter, shorter, on middle. Keegan Petersen blocks it out.
Ravichandran Ashwin comes into the attack now.
Length ball, outside off. Temba Bavuma defends it out. A maiden over for Shardul Thakur.

BEATEN AGAIN! This one is much close to the blade. A length ball, outside off. Temba Bavuma once again tries to block that off the back foot, but gets beaten as the ball zips past through the outside edge.
On a length, outside off. Temba Bavuma with a solid front foot defense.
Another fuller length ball, around middle. Temba Bavuma closes his face of the bat and pushes it to mid on once again.
Much fuller this time, around middle. Temba Bavuma drives it to mid on.
BEATEN! What a peach of a delivery by Shardul Thakur. A length delivery, outside off, some extra bounce as well. Temba Bavuma, on back foot, looks to defend but gets past the outside edge.
Length ball, on the pads this time. Temba Bavuma works it away towards mid-wicket for a single. He retains the strike.
Another length ball, outside off. Temba Bavuma leaves it alone.
Fuller ball, around middle. Keegan Petersen waits for it and drives it past mid-wicket. Ravichandran Ashwin chases the ball and keeps down to three runs.
An outswinger this time, length ball, outside off. Keegan Petersen slashes it to backward point.
On a length, outside off. Keegan Petersen blocks it out solidly.
Back of a length, shaping back in outside off. Keegan Petersen hangs back and pushes it to cover.
A length ball, outside off. Temba Bavuma offers no shot on that.
Fuller length delivery, on middle. Temba Bavuma drives it through the outer half of his blade past point for a brace.
Good-length delivery, wide of off. Keegan Petersen hangs back and cuts it towards deep cover for a single.
Full-length ball, outside off. Keegan Petersen blocks it to cover.
Touch fuller, outside off. Temba Bavuma leans and pushes it with soft hands towards point for a single.
A good-length ball, outside off. Temba Bavuma shoulders his arms at it.
Shardul Thakur (6-1-21-0) comes into the attack now.
Just a single off the over! Shami kept things tight after the pair attacked Yadav in the last over. Length ball, on top of off. Petersen keeps his eyes on the ball and blocks it out solidly.
Length, on the pads, Petersen defends it to the leg side.
Half a chance! Full-length ball, on off. Petersen looks to defend it out. The ball goes back to the aerially off the bottom end. Luckily for Petersen the ball lands short of Shami.
Fuller, outside off. Petersen defends it to cover off the front foot.
Full length, outside off. Bavuma drives it to cover for a single.
Full and on off. Bavuma blocks it out solidly.
A single to end the over! 7 runs off the over. Back of a length, outside off. Bavuma cuts it through point for a single. He retains the strike.
Three dots in a row! Fuller, on leg. Bavuma gets across and tucks it to mid on.
Short ball, outside off. Bavuma wisely leaves it alone for the keeper.
Full and outside off. Bavuma pushes it to mid off.
FOUR! Wonderfully played down the ground. Full length, outside off. Bavuma moves forward and drives it through mid off for a boundary.
On the pads, Bavuma flicks it to mid-wicket for a brace.

Length ball, on the stumps. Petersen stays inside the crease and bunts it out to the off side. A maiden for Shami this time. India have done really well to put in some dot deliveries consistently and put a lid on the run rate.
Full length, on off. Petersen blocks it back to the bowler.
Fuller, on middle. Petersen works it to mid on with full face of the blade.
Angled into the pads, on a length, Petersen stays back and defends it to the leg side.
On off, Petersen blocks it to cover.
Fuller, on off. Petersen pushes it to cover.
Mohammed Shami (8-2-21-0) is brought back into the attack.
A maiden for Yadav! Back of a length, outside off, shaping away a hint. Bavuma stays back and shoulders his arms at it.
Five dots in a row! Good length, outside off. This one climbs on the batsman. Bavuma stays back and shoulders his arms at it.
Full length, on the fourth stump line. Bavuma presses forward and defends it to cover.
Good length, outside off. Bavuma leaves it alone for the keeper.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Bavuma flicks it to mid-wicket. Not in the gap though.
Full length, on off. Bavuma stays inside the crease and defends it out watchfully.
Full length, angled in on off. Petersen stays back and defends it towards mid on.
Good length, outside off. Petersen taps it to point.
A single now! Fuller, outside off. Peterson leans in and drives it to the left of mid off. Shardul Thakur dives to his left and makes a half stop. The batters take two runs.
Full length, outside off. Keegan Petersen steps across and blocks it to cover.
Length ball, on off. Keegan Petersen gets inside the line and blocks it out solidly.

FIFTY for Keegan Petersen. How impressive has he been in this series. Touch short, on the bodyline. Keegan Petersen bends and pulls it towards deep square leg for a brace. He gets his second Test fifty in three matches.
Good-length delivery, around off. Temba Bavuma leans and pushes it towards cover. End of a successful over from Umesh Yadav.
Outside off, on a length. Temba Bavuma leaves it alone.
FOUR! What a way to get off the mark! A fuller ball, on the pads. Temba Bavuma uses his wrists and flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Length, on top of off. Bavuma blocks it out.
Temba Bavuma is the new man in.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! A much-deserved wicket for Umesh Yadav. Rassie van der Dussen was looking a little bit impatient out there. A fuller ball, around off, a hint of away movement. Rassie van der Dussen leans in and looks to drive this, but gets an outside edge towards second slip. This time the ball carries well, and Virat Kohli takes a comfortable catch to break this partnership.
Commentary.Howout: c Virat Kohli b Umesh Yadav

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller, around middle. Rassie van der Dussen drives it to mid on.
Shorter, around off. Keegan Petersen ducks underneath it.
Another good-length ball, around middle. Keegan Petersen tucks it towards mid-wicket for a dot.
On a length, around middle and leg. Keegan Petersen flicks it mid-wicket. No run there.
Shorter, outside off. Keegan Petersen pushes it towards cover off the back foot.

Another risky run! A direct hit and Rassie van der Dussen would have to walk back. A fuller ball, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen taps it cover and scampers through to the other end. Ajinkya Rahane does well to collect the ball and has a shy at the non-striker's end, but misses.
Edge and just short! A length ball, outside off. Keegan Petersen gets a bottom edge that falls just short of Pant behind the stumps.
Fuller, on the pads. Rassie van der Dussen flicks it towards mid-wicket for a brace. 9 runs off that over.
Outside off, on a length. Left alone.
Touch shorter again, outside off. Keegan Petersen pushes it towards point for a single.
Another shortish delivery, wide off. Keegan Petersen once again cuts that towards sweeper cover. Mayank Agarwal runs, dives and does well to keep it to two runs.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! Back of a length, outside off. Keegan Petersen, on back foot, creams that through cover for a boundary.

Quick single! A risky one rather. A direct hit would have been curtains for Rassie van der Dussen. A length ball, around middle and off. Rassie van der Dussen taps it towards mid-wicket and scampers through to the other end. The fielder has shy at the non-strikers end, but misses.
Length, outside off. Left alone.
Back of a length, angling it in on middle. Keegan Petersen flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Length ball, outside off. Keegan Petersen leaves it alone.
Good-length delivery, around off. Keegan Petersen blocks it towards point.
Length ball, around middle. Keegan Petersen defends that one from his crease.
Touch shorter, around middle. Keegan Petersen hops and blocks it out on the leg side.
Fuller, on middle. Rassie van der Dussen blocks it back to the bowler.
Outside off, left alone.

Review! Virat Kohli is convinced that this ball has not hit Rassie van der Dussen high and hence opts for the review. The UltraEdge shows the bat is absent. The Ball Tracker shows the ball is going over the stumps. The on-filed decision of not out stands and India lose their second review.

NOT OUT! A huge shout for LBW but the umpire says no! A length ball, around middle. Rassie van der Dussen misses his flick and gets rapped on the back pad. A huge appeal by the Indians, but the umpire is unmoved. Virat Kohli goes for the review. The replay rolls in. UltraEdge shows no spike as the ball passes through the bat. Ball  Tracker indicated that would have missed the wickets. Inda lose another review and Rassie van der Dussen survives.
BEATEN! Sharp away swing for Umesh Yadav. A length ball outside off. Rassie van der Dussen tried to have a poke at it away from his body, but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Good-length delivery, around off. Rassie van der Dussen blocks it out.
Umesh Yadav begins with a length ball, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen allows that one to go through.

The second session is set to begin. The Indian players stride out to the middle. Followed by Keegan Petersen and Rassie van der Dussen who walk out to bat for South Africa. Umesh Yadav to steam in with the ball.
... Day 2, Session 2 ...

India would be really happy with their performance with the ball but might feel they were unlucky as they got a lot of edges but did not find much success off it. Bumrah and Shami both bowled with fire and kept things tight. Bumrah did not take much time to have an impact and sent back Markram in the very first over. Yadav and Thakur combined well, as the former got a wicket of Maharaj but you can say they erred their lines and could not keep the batters under the pump. India would hope they can break this stand in the second session and get the momentum back to their side. Do join us at 1640 IST (1110 GMT) for another thrilling session of Test cricket.

A sigh of relief for the hosts! Maharaj who injured his hamstring at the end of Day 1, came in with a strap on his thigh and batted beautifully even after losing Markram on just the second delivery of the day. During his time out in the middle with Petersen, he was the aggressor in this stand before he fell out. Later Petersen showed good temperament and grew into his innings to stitch a crucial partnership with Rassie van der Dussen of 55 runs and remained unscathed till the Lunch break. Proteas would hope the pair can stick around for long in the next session as well with the deficit down to 123 runs.

What an intriguing session this one was! Both the teams fought really hard and, in the end, South Africa would be happy to see Keegan Petersen and Rassie van der Dussen walk out of the field at the end of the first session. While, India would be feeling hard done by.
Full-length, on the pads. Rassie van der Dussen flicks it towards fine leg for a single. That brings up the 100 for South Africa. That will be Lunch on Day 2!
Another fuller length, around off. Rassie van der Dussen pushes it towards mid off once again.
Fuller, around off. Rassie van der Dussen blocks it towards mid off.
Maintains the same line and length. Good length, again in that channel outside off, a little bit of late swing on that. Rassie van der Dussen shoulders his arms to it.
Another length ball, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen offers no shot on that.
A good-length delivery, in that channel outside off. Rassie van der Dussen does well to leave it.
Length, outside off. Left alone.

FOUR! A short ball, outside off. Keegan Petersen hangs back and pushes it towards cover. Mayank Agarwal puts in a chase, slides, and stops the ball. He collects the ball, but his leg seems to be touching the boundary ropes at the same time. Virat Kohli is not happy with that.
A length ball, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen pushes it towards cover and takes a single.

NOT OUT! An appeal for caught behind but the umpire says no. A length ball, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen looks to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge. Virat Kohli and Jasprit Bumrah seem to have heard something there. But decides not to take the review.
Another length ball, around middle. Rassie van der Dussen blocks it out.
A length ball, outside off, that one stayed low. Rassie van der Dussen defends it out.
Full-length, outisde off. Rassie van der Dussen leans forward and pushes it through cover for a quick single.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Keegan Petersen flicks it towards mid-wicket and takes a run.
Another flighted delivery, full and on middle. Blocked out by Keegan Petersen
Loopy ball, on middle. Keegan Petersen presses forwards and defends it out.
Flatter, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen hangs back and taps it towards point for a single.
Tossing it up, full and on middle. Rassie van der Dussen lunges and blocks it out.
Touch shorter again, outside off. Keegan Petersen pushes it towards past point for a couple of runs.
Shorter ball, outside off. Keegan Petersen, on back foot, cuts miscues his cut shot towards cover.
Full once again, on middle. Keegan Petersen pushes it on the right of the bowler. No run taken as mid on will get to it on time.
Tad fuller, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen taps it towards cover and scampers through to the other end.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen shoulders his arms to it.
Fuller length, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen drives it to the fielder at mid off.
Jasprit Bumrah (9-4-8-2) is back into the attack.
Fuller, around middle. Petersen works it away towards mid on.
Short again, on midde, quicker this time. Keegan Petersen, hangs back and blocks it out solidly.
Shorter, on middle. Keegan Petersen taps it to the fielder at short leg.
FOUR! Beautifully done! A loopy ball, full, around off. Keegan Petersen gets low and reverse-sweeps this towards third man for a boundary.
Flatter, around off. Keegan Petersen taps it towards short leg.
loopy ball, full and on off. Keegan Petersen leans and blocks it out.
Short in length, on the body. Keegan Petersen pulls it toward deep square leg for a single.
Touch shorter, outside off again. Keegan Petersen shoulders his arms to it. Well left!
Back of a length, outside off. Keegan Petersen pushes it to the fielder at cover.
FOUR! Sweetly timed! Shardul Thakur overpitches this one, around middle and leg. Keegan Petersen uses his wrists and flicks it away towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
BEATEN! A JAFFA! Shardul Thakur forcing the batter to play. A length ball, outside off. Keegan Petersen looks to drive but gets beaten as the ball shapes away a tad from him.
Fuller delivery, outside off. Keegan Petersen leans and blocks it towards cover.
Full and on middle. Rassie van der Dussen defends it to point off the outer half.
Flighted, full and on off. Rassie van der Dussen defends it solidly.
On a length, turning in. Rassie van der Dussen stands tall and blocks it to cover.
Around off, Rassie van der Dussen goes back and defends it to the off side.
Flighted, full and outside off. Rassie van der Dussen presses forward and blocks it onto the deck.
Floated, full and on off. Rassie van der Dussen defends it watchfully to short leg.
Ravichandran Ashwin comes into the attack.
A dot to end the over! This is a beauty! Good-length ball, outside off, shaping away. Petersen looks to chase it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Full length, outside off. Petersen blocks it to the off side.

FOUR! Runs are coming in thick and fast for South Africa now. Back of a length, outside off. Keegan Petersen frees his arms and cuts it over point for a boundary. He keeps growing in confidence with the time he spends on the crease. This is a crucial partnership for South Africa.
Nice bowling! A length ball, around off. Petersen gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Full length, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen pushes it to cover.
Full, on middle and leg. Rassie van der Dussen flicks it to the man at mid-wicket.
Full and on middle. Rassie van der Dussen flicks it to square leg for a single.
LEG BYE! Fuller, on the pads. Petersen misses his flick. The ball goes off the pads towards square leg. They collect a leg bye.
FOUR! Nicely played. Touch short, on off. Petersen hangs back and lofts it over covers for a boundary.

Great awarness by Yadav. Full-length ball, outside off. Petersen blocks it back to the bowler. Yadav gets low but rather then collecting the ball and helps it behind with and strikes the stump on the non-striker's end. Rassie van der Dussen was well inside the crease.
Length ball, angling down leg. Petersen looks to flick it away but misses. Pant does well to gather the ball.
Fuller, on the pads. Rassie van der Dussen hangs back and flicks it to deep square leg for a single.

BEATEN! Good-length ball, outside off, shaping away a hint. Keegan Petersen is drawn forward as he looks to defend it out but gets beaten on the outside edge. Kohli and Thakur put in a loud appeal but the umpire is not interested. Certainly Kohli thinks he heard something, but other players deny it and he opts against the review.
Good length, outside off. Petersen blocks it out to cover.
Very full, on leg. Rassie van der Dussen flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Slightly short, outside off, shaping away. Rassie van der Dussen shoulders his arms at it.
Full length, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen presses forward and defends it out solidly.
Outside off, left alone by Rassie van der Dussen.
FOUR! Nicely played! Full length, wide outside off. Petersen expands himself and drives it through cover-point for a boundary.
Good length, around off, nips back in. Petersen looks to defend it out but misses and gets hit high on the pads. Yadav puts in a stifled appeal but the umpire says no.
Fuller, on off, nips in a bit. Rassie van der Dussen gets it to fine leg off the inner half. They take a single.
Tad fuller, angling it on the pads. Rassie van der Dussen flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Good length, in the corridor of uncertainty. Rassie van der Dussen shuffles across and shoulders his arms at it.
Full, on off. Rassie van der Dussen blocks it back to the bowler.
Good length, on top of off. Petersen defends it out watchfully.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Petersen stays back and defends it towards mid on.
Length, on off. Petersen comes across and blocks it back to the bowler.
BEATEN! This is nice bowling! Good length, outside off. Some extra bounce off the deck. Petersen was keen to push it away but pull his blade back it time after seeing the ball fly through.
Good length, on off. Petersen defends it out.
Edge and short once again! A fuller ball, angling it away from outside off. Keegan Petersen looks to defend but gets an outside edge that falls just short of Virat Kohli at second slip.
Tad fuller, angling it in on the pads. Rassie van der Dussen clips it towards mid-wicket. Two runs taken.
LEG BYE! Good-length delivery, around the pads. Keegan Petersen misses flick and gets hit on the pads. The ball then rolls towards fine leg. The batters steal a leg bye.
Quick single! A fuller ball, around middle. Rassie van der Dussen works it towards mid on and takes off for a single.
A length ball, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen strides and leaves it alone.
Back of a length, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen leaves it alone.
Touch fuller, on the pads. Keegan Petersen tucks it towards fine leg for a single.

Edge and just short! A length ball, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen gets an outside edge towards Virat Kohli at first slip. The ball flies and does not carry to him there. An eventful over comes to an end.
Fuller again, around middle. Rassie van der Dussen blocks it with soft hannds and gets an outside edge past the diving gully fielder for two runs.
Touch fuller, on the pads. Keegan Petersen works it towards mid-wicket for a single.

Review! Virat Kohli takes the review for LBW. The on-field decision is not out. The UltraEdge confirms no bat is involved. The Ball Tracker shows the ball is missing the wickets. India lose a review here.

NOT OUT! Huge shout for LBW, but the umpire is unmoved. A length ball, nipping back in on middle. Keegan Petersen misses his flick and gets rapped on the back pad. A huge shout but the umpire says no. Shardul Thakur is convinced he has got his man. Virat Kohli goes up for the review. The replay rolls in. UltraEdge confirms no bat involved. Ball Tracker indicates the ball would be missing the wickets. The on-field decision stands and India lose a review.
FOUR! PUNISHED! A short ball, wide of off. Keegan Petersen stands tall, and punches it through covers for a boundary. Keegan Petersen is capitalizing on the bad deliveries.
Fuller, on the pads. Keegan Petersen works it to the fielder at mid on.
Back of a length, outside off. Keegan Petersen taps it towards cover and takes a single. He will keep strike for the next over.
Good-length delivery, on the pads. Rassie van der Dussen flicks it to mid-wicket and takes a single.
A length ball, shaping away from outside off. Keegan Petersen pushes it with the outer half of his blade towards gully. A little fumble at gully allows the batters to complete a single.
A fuller ball, around middle and off. Rassie van der Dussen drives it towards cover and scampers through to the other end. Rassie van der Dussen gets off the mark with that.

DRINKS! India have enjoyed the first hour of the first session. They have taken two scalps and would look to chip away a couple more wickets before the session ends. South Africa are in a spot of bother now. They need the current pair to remain unscathed until the end of the session. Rassie van der Dussen joins Keegan Petersen in the middle now.

OUT! CLEANED HIM UP! Umesh Yadav strikes this time, the cameo by Keshav Maharaj has come to an end. A beauty by Umesh Yadav! A length ball, around middle. Keshav Maharaj looks to drive this but gets beaten on the inside edge as the ball nips back in and uproots the middle stump. South Africa are now 3 down.
Good-length delivery, shaping away from outside off. Keshav Maharaj leaves it alone for the keeper to collect it.
EDGY! A full-length ball, on leg. Petersen looks to flick it away. But gets the leading edge and the ball goes towards. Petersen hit it with soft hands and hence it did not carry much.
Full length, outside off. Petersen comes across and defends it to cover.
On off, Petersen defends it out.
Full length, on off. Maharaj defends it to cover. The ball goes through the fielder there and the batters were quick to scamper through for a single.
Length and on off. Maharaj defends it to mid off.
A full-length ball, on the pads. Maharaj stays back and clips it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Shardul Thakur is brought into the attack. He replaces Mohammed Shami.
A good start by Yadav. A maiden off the first over of the day. On a length, on off. Petersen defends it out watchfully.
Full length, on the stumps. Petersen presses forward and gets it to mid-wicket off the inner half.
Length, on off, blocked out.

BIG SHOUT! But the umpire just nods his head. A length ball, around off, nips in off the deck. Keegan Petersen stays inside the crease and looks to defend it out but misses. He gets pinged high on the pads. Maybe, going down leg with the angle.
Length and outside off. Keegan Petersen pushes it to cover. Not in the gap though.
Good length, wide outside off. Keegan Petersen lets it go to the keeper.
Umesh Yadav (2-0-10-0) comes into the attack.
Shami follows the instruction and bowls it full and on off. Maharaj stays inside the crease and defends it out watchfully.
Full length, outside off. Maharaj leaves it alone for the keeper. Some from the slip cordon passes on a message to Shami, as he says maintain the same line and let the batter hit.
FOUR! Gorgeous shot! Maharaj gets himself into a good position and makes the most of it. Full length, on off. Maharaj leans in and creams it through covers for a boundary.
Length ball, on the fourth stump line. Maharaj defends it back to the bowler off the bottom of the blade.
Fuller, on middle. Maharaj defends it to mid off.
Good length, just outside off. Maharaj stays back and pushes it towards cover with soft hands.
On a length, on off stump. Petersen stays inside the crease and blocks it out with the full face of the blade.
Length, on off. Petersen blocks it out to covers.
Bumrah creating angles now! Good length outside off. He draws Petersen forward but wisely shoulders his arms at it.
Back of a length, wide outside off. Keegan Petersen has no stroke to offer.
Good length, outside off. Petersen leaves it alone for the keeper.
Maharaj is riding his luck really well. A full-length ball, on off. Maharaj gets an inside edge towards square leg. They take a single.
On off, defended out solidly by Petersen this time.

This is excellent bowling! Keegan Petersen has his eyes wide open after this delivery. A length ball, on the fourth stump line. Some extra bounce and shape away off the deck. Keegan Petersen strides forward and looks to defend it out but gets beaten on the outside edge.

Shami is asking all the right questions here. A length ball, on off. Keegan Petersen hangs his blade out. The ball goes off the outside edge towards the right of gully. Rahane dives to his right to make a sharp stop.
Length, on off. Keegan Petersen blocks it out wathcfully.

A tough chance, goes down for India. A good-length delivery, on off. Petersen looks to defend it out but gets an outside edge towards third slip. KL Rahul there goes down to his right but spills it out. He gets his fingers underneath but was unable to keep it in control.

Play and a miss! A full-length ball, wide outside off. Keegan Petersen expands himself and looks to go for the booming drive but misses. The ball zips past the outside edge. This delivery has made the slip cordon chirpy.
Touch fuller, around the fourth stump line. Keshav Maharaj pushes it to the fielder at cover.
Length, around that channel outside off. Keegan Petersen, on back foot, taps it to cover and scampers through to the other end.
On a length, outside the off pole again. Keegan Petersen shoulders arms to it.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Keegan Petersen pushes it towards cover. No run taken.
Tad fuller, shaping back in on the pads. Keshav Maharaj flicks it towards mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
A length ball, outside off. Keshav Maharaj lets that go through to the keeper.
First maiden for Shami. This is beautiful bowling. On a length, on off. Keegan Petersen stays back and defends it to covers watchfully.
Good length, outside off, shaping away. Keegan Petersen shuffles across and shoulders his arms at it.
Shorter length, outside off, at 137 clicks. Keegan Petersen, hops and blocks it on the off side.
Good-length delivery, on middle. Keegan Petersen shows the full face of the bat ad defends it out.
BEATEN! Back of a length, outside off. Keegan Petersen tries to defend it but gets beaten on the outside edge.

Edged and just short! A fuller ball, around off. Keegan Petersen blocks it but gets an outside edge towards third slip. the ball flies an lands just short of the fielder there, who collects it on a bounce.
Swing and a miss! Length and outside off. Keshav Maharaj swings at it but fails to get any bat on it.
Shorter ball, around middle. Keshav Maharaj ducks under it.
Angling in from wide of off, fuller length. Keshav Maharaj pushes it to cover.
Touch fuller, around middle. Keegan Petersen works it towards mid on for a single.
Another length ball, outside off. Keegan Petersen shoulders arms to it. The umpire calls it a no ball, as the bowler oversteps.
Good-length delivery, shaping back in on middle. Keegan Petersen blocks it solidly.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Keegan Petersen pushes it to cover. He wants a single but decides against it at the end.
A full-length ball, on off. Maharaj stays back and gets his blade down in time to block it out.
FOUR! Glorious shot! Back of a length, outside off. Keshav Maharaj stands tall, hangs back, and punches it through cover for a boundary.
Tad fuller, around middle and leg. Keshav Maharaj gets an outside edge towards cover. No run there.
ANother length ball, attacking the off pole. Keshav Maharaj blocks it out.
BEATEN! On a length, outside off. Keshav Maharaj, hangs back and looks to defend, but he gets beaten as the ball whizzes past the outside edge.
Touch fuller, around off. Keshav Maharaj lunges and blocks it out.
Another ripper! Good-length length delivery, around off. Keegan Petersen leaves it alone, the ball nips back in sharply and flies over the off pole.
Back of a length, outside off. Keegan Petersen blocks it out watchfully.
Length ball, around off. Keshav Maharaj gets an inside edge towards fine leg. A single taken.

FOUR BYES! A JAFFA! What a peach of a delivery! A length ball, around middle. Keshav Maharaj tries to block it but gets beaten as the ball nips back in sharply. Keshav Maharaj gets beaten on the inside edge and the ball flies over the middle pole. Rishabh Pant dives to his left but fails to stop the ball, as it races away all the way towards the fine leg fence for a boundary. Bouns runs here for South Africa.
Another length ball, outside off. Keshav Maharaj shoulders arms to it.
Length ball, outside off, at 137 clicks. Keshav Maharaj lets that go through.
Good-length delivery, shaping away from outside off. Keegan Petersen leaves it alone.
A length ball, around the thigh pads. Keshav Maharaj tucks it towards fine leg for a single.
Swing and a miss! This one was on a length, outside off. Keshav Maharaj looks to have a poke at it, but gets beaten as the ball shapes away from him a tad.
Touch fuller, around the off pole again. Keshav Maharaj leans and defends it out.
Good-length delivery, around off. Keshav Maharaj blocks it out solidly.

FOUR! EDGY! Shami serves a fuller delivery, on middle. Keshav Maharaj looks to blocks this, but gets a thick outside edge between third slip and gully. The ball races away towards thrid man fence for a boundary.
Mohammed Shami to bowl from the other end.
Back of a length, around the off pole. Keegan Petersen, hops and blocks it out solidly. Ed of a successful over by Jasprit Bumrah.
Another short-pitched delivery, wide of off. Keegan Petersen blocks it to cover.
Shorter again, around off. Keegan Petersen punches it to cover off the back foot.
Back of a length, outside off, Keegan Petersen, on back foot, pushes it past gully for a brace. South Africa are up and running on Day 2.
Keegan Petersen is the new man in.

OUT! TIMBER! A dream start for India and Jasprit Bumrah. A peach of a delivery! An error of judgment costs Aiden Markram his wicket. A length ball, on off. Aiden Markram looks to leave the ball. The ball nips back in from outside off and knocks the off stump over. Bumrah still hasn't conceded a single a run, but has got two wickets to his name.
Jasprit Bumrah begins with a length delivery, outside off. Aiden Markram looks to defend but gets an outside edge towards gully.

The first session is set to begin. Virat Kohli leads his side onto the field. Followed by Aiden Markram and Keshav Maharaj who walk out with their blades. Jasprit Bumrah to steam in with the ball. Here we go...

Cheteshwar Pujara is down for a chat. He says there is enough in it for the bowlers. It is a very good cricketing pitch, even the batters can score on it. Mentions that the batters need to know what kind of shots to play, and once the batsman is set he can make it count. He could not do it, but Virat did very well. Adds that they should have scored 30-40 runs more, but they are very confident they can bowl well, they have one of the best bowling attacks in the world, and they can restrict South Africa. Concludes by saying that, if they bowl well, third innings it will be the best wicket to bat on, and they have to make sure to make it count and 275 is a good total on this pitch.

After their chase in the previous game, South Africa will be high on confidence and will be thinking they can take the lead from here, despite losing their skipper, Dean Elgar. We witnessed a Virat Kohli masterclass yesterday and now it’s upto the bowlers. A few early wickets in the first session will surely put India in the driver's seat. Will India put South Africa in trouble? Or will the hosts score big? Let’s find out. A thrilling first session awaits.

Hello and a warm welcome to Day 2 of this exciting Test match between South Africa and India. We witnessed a fast-moving Day 1, a total of 11 wickets fell. Although the day belonged to South Africa, the visitors will be happy after picking up the prized scalp of Dean Elgar.
... Day 2, Session 1 ...

Right. That is all from Day 1. We will be back for Day 2 on 12th January so do join us for the same. The day is scheduled to start at 2:00 pm IST (8:30 am GMT) but our buildup begins early on, so do join us for that. Till then, Adios!

India, on the other hand, have shown a decent batting performance. Virat Kohli was the lone wolf, who guided India past 200 runs. While India kept losing wickets in a cluster, Virat Kohli stood tall. He seemed like a different player today. He displayed his class and gave the bowlers something to bowl at. Cheteshwar Pujara did show some grit and resilience in the middle, but he failed to carry on. But, they have done well to grab an early wicket. Indian bowlers will not make it easy for South Africa to take the lead, even though they have an opportunity to go ahead.

After being asked to bowl first, South Africa have done a phenomenal job to bundle out India for a below-par score of 223. Kagiso Rabada was surely the leader of the pack. He managed to grab four wickets including that of the India, skipper, Virat Kohli. Marco Jansen too was exceptional and managed to grab three wickets. Ngidi and Duanne Olivier picked a wicket each, but they were very disciplined throughout the innings. Coming into bat, South Africa have lost their skipper early. Markram and Keshav Maharaj have done well to survive and they will be hoping to continue the same way.

End of a thrilling day of Test cricket. South Africa will be the happier side at the end of Day 1! A scintillating bowling performance from the hosts. But India have certainly ended the day on a high after grabbing the big wicket of Dean Elgar.
Well played Keshav Maharaj! He has done his job! Full ball, almost a yorker, on middle, this is hit to mid-wicket. That will be Stumps on Day 1.
FOUR! Keshav Maharaj won't mind it! A full ball, outside off. Keshav Maharaj defends it away from the body and gets a thick outside edge to backward point. Boundary.
A length ball, around off, steep bounce and Keshav Maharaj sways away from the line of the ball.
Full ball, angling on middle. Keshav Maharaj pushes it to mid on.
Pitches it up, on off, this is pushed to mid off.
On a length, on off. Keshav Maharaj blocks it on the off side. Survival time for him.
Another solid block from Aiden Markram and Maharaj will face the potential last over.
Very full, slanting on middle. Aiden Markram jams it out to the bowler.
Outside off. Left alone.
Fuller ball, on off. Aiden Markram blocks it to the leg side.
Angles a length ball, on off. Defended out.
Length ball, outside off. Aiden Markram leaves it alone.
Almost squared up but Keshav Maharaj defends it low and on the ground to the off side.
BEATEN! The ball whizzes past the blade. On a length, outside off. Keshav Maharaj looks to defend but misses.
Bangs a short ball, on middle. Keshav Maharaj sit under it.
A fuller ball, outside off. Keshav Maharaj leans and pushes it to deep extra cover. Two runs taken. He gets off the mark with that.

A slight halt in play. Not sure whether Keshav Maharaj is really struggling or it is just a tactic to waste time. Whatever it is, he is doing really well. The physio checks and we are ready to resume.

Quick single! Aiden Markram takes a single and gives the strike to the night-watchmen. On middle, this is hit to mid on where the fielder has a shy at the keeper's end but misses. With the reaction from the fielders behind the stump. It looked close.
This one lands outside off and shapes away. Aiden Markram leaves it alone.
Mohammed Shami comes into the attack.
Bumrah goes wide of the crease and angles it on middle. Maharaj gets his bat down in time and tucks it to mid-wicket. Keshav Maharaj survives...
On a length, on off. Blocked out.
Keshav Maharaj, the night watchman, walks in to bat at number 3.

OUT! TAKEN! What a delivery from Bumrah! Dean Elgar was facing some difficulties and Bumrah continued to bowl in that channel. On a length, angling around off. Dean Elgar is squared up as he looks to defend and gets a thick outside edge to first slip where Cheteshwar Pujara holds on to it.
Commentary.Howout: c Cheteshwar Pujara b Jasprit Bumrah

Commentary.Commentary: Length and on off, this is hit to gully.
EDGED! This is full and drifting, around off. Dean Elgar is squared up as he looks to push with soft hands and gets an outside edge to second slip who collects it on a bounce.
A length ball,angling on off, extra pace from Bumrah. Elgar defends it more off the inner half and back on the deck.

FOUR! Top-shot to end the over! An overpitched delivery, on middle. Aiden Markram drives it past mid on for a boundary. Too full and too straight on this occasion, and Markram makes full use of this one.
On a length, outside off. Aiden Markram leaves it alone.
Lenght ball, on middle. Aiden Markram shows the full face of his bat and blocks it out.
Good-length delivery, on middle. Aiden Markram pushes it uppishly straight down the ground for two runs.
A length ball, on the pads. Dean Elgar tucks it towards mid-wicket. A single taken.
Short of a length, outside off. Dean shoulders arms to it.
BEATEN! Good channel from Jasprit Bumrah! A length ball, angling around off, it holds its line. Aiden Markram looks to defend inside it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Touch fuller, way outside off. Aiden Markram shoulders arms to it.
Fullish delivery, slanting on middle. Aiden Markram gets behind the line of the ball to keep it out.
On a length, on middle. Aiden Markram hops and blocks it out.
Full again but way outside off. Easy leave.
Full and angling on off. Blocked out on the off side.
Fuller ball, outside off. Elgar offers no shot to this one.
Length and on off. Dean Elgar defends it right under his eyes. Not much movement for Indian bowlers yet.
Dean Elgar is off the mark as well. Full and outside off, this is punched through covers for a brace.
Full, slanting across, outside off. Left alone.
South Africa and Aiden Markram are underway! A length ball, around off. Aiden Markram defends it off the outer half through point and gets a single.
Length and on off. Aiden Markram blocks it out.
Umesh Yadav will bowl from the other end.
BEATEN! A JAFFA! Jasprit Bumrah serves a length ball, shaping it away outside off. Dean Elgar looks to have a poke at it but gets beaten on the outside edge. A maiden to begin with!
Ouchh! Elgar is feeling the sting of the blow! A length ball, targeting the pads. Elgar misses his flick and gets hit between the thigh guard and front pad.
A length ball, angling across, outside off. Elgar taps it to point.
Serves a short ball, outside off. Elgar shoulders arms to it.
Full and on the pads, this is flicked to mid-wicket. Shardul Thakur there does really well to get low and stop it.
Bumrah starts with a length ball, on middle. Elgar blocks it out.
